name: Elbert Greetia
original_name: エルバート・グリーティア
source:
A sorrowful nobleman with a peerless beauty like a bisque doll. Belongs to Crown.

He obsessively collects "beautiful things" and leaves them messy in his room.

There seems to be a heartbreaking reason for this intense desire...?

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Snow White's Queen

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#elbert]official website[/url]]
